chapter: Learning the drums and early influences
title: The first drum set and playing the back beat
summary: Crawford and Crouch reconstruct his first set of bass drum, snare and small sock cymbal, played on two and four.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Okay, I'm going to run this forward and turn this tape over.
-- so you had a huge bass drum (and a snare drum) And did you play any cymbals, your first set?
Well, I had one cymbal sitting up there. But mostly press rolls.
What did you use that, like the for crasheps?
Yeah, crashes and whatnot, on the floor, foot cymbal.
Oh, you had a small -- you had a small -- small sock cymbal, about 12 inches.
Right. So okay, now we got the set. Big bass drum, snare drum, small sock cymbal and one --
That you had to put your foot through a strap to maintain it steady and go up and down with it.
Now, did you use this -- did you play this on every beat or did you play it --
You played it on two and four.
I had enough sense -- enough to do that.
